originality.rationale: Borsotti 2026 proves ε|log ε| shifts for common-diagonal Jordan nilpotents and block-direct sums, not arbitrary acyclic positive varying off-diagonal feeds; Kaklamanos 2023 treats two-variable leading exit selection. The combined graph-wide finite-ε uniform bound and exact non-Jordan feed occupation law were not found as corollaries of the directly inspected primary claims. General path-Laplace priority remains uncertain.
residual_risks: A more general pre-existing positive linear-system path-integral or semiclassical Laplace theorem could imply the uniform error estimate; database search is not uniqueness proof.
Hsu–Ruan and Campbell–Rose publisher full texts were not accessed; abstract-only comparisons cannot certify that their full works do not contain a stronger lemma.

The sharp Gaussian example is a transparent application of the classical Laplace method; originality is in the all-graph uniform statement and linked exit-time/supply-time characterization, not in the Gaussian integral alone.
